body: Refresh() now dedups articles.ndjson rows by ID (last-write-wins) before building the in-memory Store, fixing duplicate cards from same-day writer re-runs/retries (movers-watcher and similar, S167-03's own finding). No live NDJSON duplicates existed at fix time so no migration was needed. Pattern mirrors docindex's last-write-wins correction logic. go test ./... green, deployed to fatbaby-newssite, verified live.
title: S167-05: commentary.Store dedups by article ID, last-write-wins
